description: A sealed WebRTC offer, in the offerer's repo. Record key: <answerer DID>.<session TID>. The answerer learns of it from Jetstream and our relay (collection filter), reads it with one getRecord, and answers once; the offerer deletes it once answered.

ciphertext.description: age-armored JSON {sdp, replyTo}, sealed to the answerer's listen key; replyTo is the offerer's one-session age recipient.

createdAt.description: Answerers ignore an offer older than 2 minutes.
